item.title: Bulletin updated at 07:45 HKT 21/Nov/2023
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
With the northeast monsoon moderating slightly, temperatures will rise during the day over the coastal areas of southern China in the next couple of days. The weather will be persistently fine and dry with rather large temperature difference between day and night. A strong northeast monsoon is expected to reach the coast of Guangdong towards the weekend. It will be windier and slightly cooler over the region during the weekend and early next week.
